title: Filipino-Style Mexican Yeast Dumplings
description: Soft, fluffy dumplings filled with tender beef and spices, inspired by Filipino flavors and Mexican heat.

ingredients.name: filipino spices
ingredients.notes: ground ginger, garlic, and onion powder

instructions: Combine flour, water, and a pinch of salt to form the dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of beef in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the beef to form a half-moon shape.
Seal the edges with a fork.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the dumplings until they are golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Serve warm with your favorite dipping sauce.
